fields.title: Welcome to PNOI
fields.content:
Welcome to **PNOI**, the Penchick National Olympiad in Informatics: a place for Filipino students to practise competitive programming and compete in online contests.

Here is how to get started:

1. **Solve a problem.** Open the [problem list](/problems/), pick a problem, write your solution in C++ or Python, and submit it. The judge tells you within seconds whether it is correct.
2. **Join a contest.** Rated contests will be announced here and on the [contests page](/contests/). Your rating goes up or down depending on how you do.
3. **Add your school.** Put your school and grade on [your profile](/edit/profile/) to appear in your school's ranking.

New here? Read the [About page](/about/) first. Good luck, and have fun!
